g.text: Domain rules, application-owned contracts, replaceable adapters
+check_eligibility(subtotal : int, evaluatedAt : DateTime, currency : String) : void
+quote(cart : Cart, currency : String, couponCode : Optional<String>, evaluatedAt : DateTime) : PriceQuote
An unvalidated request may have zero lines.
The lines association is a read-only Python tuple, not duplicate storage.
validate requires a nonempty Cart and integer quantity 1..99, excluding Boolean.
subtotal uses only resolved trusted prices; CNY nonnegative integer cents.
Immutable value parts may be shared: association, not exclusive composition.
Eligibility checks integer minimum, CNY, UTC expiry, then time and threshold.
Policy construction checks kind-specific configuration separately.
Negative minimum policy is explicitly outside the verified baseline.
Construction is lifecycle behavior, not a modeled ordinary operation.
Same accepted subtotal domain for every implementation:
nonnegative integer cents, CNY; result in 0..subtotal;
deterministic, no input or policy-state mutation.
Finite shared contract cases support, but do not prove universal substitution.
PolicyFactory = callable(Coupon) -> DiscountPolicy, registered at composition root.
Default fixed/percentage factories validate their parameters.
Extension may add a factory and registration; core workflow remains unchanged.
MC-01 is the stable model identity. Class identities are enumerated in provenance.md.
Python Mapping, Optional, Tuple, DateTime and callable types have explicit mappings there.
Typed state describes validated use; deliberately malformed inputs are refused at validation.
No persistence, order capability, framework or catalog network client is introduced.
